continuation.text:
I rewrote `src/solution.py` and did not run it or write any checks.

I removed the rules the requirements don't ask for:
- the 12:00–13:00 lunch block
- the Friday rule that stopped meetings starting after 15:00
- the 15-minute buffer after each event
- the conversion of date strings to weekday names

I kept the behaviour the requirements do describe:
- Start times are every 15 minutes between 09:00 and 17:00, and the meeting must end by 17:00.
- A meeting can't overlap an existing event. It can start exactly when an event ends, or end exactly when one starts.
- The function returns an empty list when nothing fits, or when the duration is not a positive integer or is longer than the working day.
- Events with an end time at or before their start time are ignored.

I also gave `day` a default of `None`. It is still accepted but no longer affects the result. I fixed the garbled characters in the docstring.
